2126327869605380250.en_summary: $GOOGL is the cheapest of the Magnificent Seven on trailing earnings (~16x). Google Cloud revenue +103% YoY to $30.7B last quarter, total revenue +25%, Search still printing cash. Market pricing it like a company being disrupted by AI, but numbers look like the company doing the disrupting. Don't always need high-beta. Target for 2027? $400+
2126327869605380250.zh_summary: $GOOGL 是 Magnificent Seven 中按追蹤盈利計算最便宜的（約16倍）。Google Cloud 收入同比增長103%至上季307億美元，總收入增長25%，搜尋仍在印鈔。市場將其定價為被AI顛覆的公司，但數字看起來像是在進行顛覆的公司。不一定需要高貝塔。2027年目標？400美元以上

ticker_notes.GOOGL: 約16倍追蹤盈利最便宜，Cloud +103%至307億，2027目標400+

2126326029728063994.en_summary: On Nov. 25, the 13-week U.S. Treasury bill (IRX), a three-month benchmark for dollar credit, was quoted at a 4.16% discount rate. Stretch ($STRC) had a 12.24% effective yield. Our ambition is for Stretch to become the three-month benchmark for Digital Credit built on Bitcoin.
2126326029728063994.zh_summary: 11月25日，13週美國國庫券（IRX），美元信貸的三個月基準，報價為4.16%貼現率。Stretch（$STRC）有效收益率為12.24%。我們的抱負是讓Stretch成為基於比特幣的數字信貸的三個月基準。
